Plugin.Name: Fluxer for Unraid
Plugin.Overview:
Unraid® is a registered trademark of Lime Technology, Inc. This application is not affiliated with, endorsed, or sponsored by Lime Technology, Inc.
Unofficial beta installer for a new Fluxer instance on Unraid 7. Install Compose Manager Plus first. The Settings page configures the official Docker Compose stack. Web access uses Cloudflare Tunnel and Traefik.
Calls connect directly through router forwards for TCP 7881 and UDP 7882 to the NAS LAN address. LiveKit detects the public IP address automatically. Callers need no VPN. Setup requires Cloudflare DNS and tunnel tokens. Removing this plugin keeps existing containers and data.
